name: 🎲 Obby Roulette!
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Obby Shuffle!
Face randomly generated mini obbies that change every ~20 seconds, ranging from easy wins to near impossible challenges. Earn ⭐ stars by completing rounds based on difficulty, then spend them on cosmetics and more. Can you keep up?

⭐If you would like to build a map, join the community server. 

⭐Join the group for +2 stars per win!


https://www.roblox.com/communities/626657866/Obby-Maniacs#!/about
